quizName:
Hardest Questions in Massachusetts
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a railroad crossing is ahead. Look and listen for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate is lowered.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not pay attention to how many tracks there are to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: Always look and listen for trains at railroad crossings. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from the task of driving

questions.explanation: A distraction takes your eyes, hands, or attention away from driving. Any distraction can cause a crash.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: You must focus on driving. Any activity that takes your attention away from the road is dangerous.

questions.question: When you borrow an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend, you should:

options.text: Not worry because all vehicles are the same.
Hide from your friend that you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious defects to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes before driving to learn how to use all the vehicle's equipment.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes before driving to learn how to use all the vehicle's equipment.
questions.explanation: Before driving, find the turn signals, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, and horn. Check that everything works. Fix any problems before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: You should slow down:

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in curves, near pedestrians, and on wet or slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park at this location.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol harms your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if you do not see other cars.
Signal only if other cars are nearby.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if you do not see other cars.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or pulling away from the curb. Do not skip signaling just because you see no traffic. This is the law.

questions.question: You are angry after something happens at work. When you reach your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: If you are angry or upset, calm down before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and give the right-of-way to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: When stopped by police for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must carry and show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. These are required when driving.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: Your ability to drive safely can be hurt by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness all make driving unsafe.

questions.question: Who must wear a safety belt in a car?
questions.explanation: Everyone in a car must wear a safety belt or use a child safety seat. Drivers who do not wear a belt can be fined $25. Passengers age 16 and older who do not wear a belt can be fined $25.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic when the light is green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic must yield to oncoming traffic when the light is green.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road hazards. This sign warns of bicycles crossing the road ahead.
